notes.title: New playable characters, night time and bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey Pug lovers,

So we've introduced 6 new characters to play as, a new night time sequence. (Hint hint, play as Pumpkin pug at night)

We've also made a bug fix, so hopefully people will stop cheating the leaderboards now. The leaderboards will reset for the last time until the end date of the competition, which ends on the 1st of December. Please see the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/418070/discussions/0/490125103642364133/]Turbo Pug competition thread 	[/url] for details.

Please continue to enjoy Turbo Pug, we're working hard on Pug#2 and also, please stop squishing your pugs, how many times do I need to ask?

Thanks,
Dan.ːMerryPugmasː

notes.title: Patch #1 - Turbo Pug now supports 64 and 32 bit! - Competition(Win Fallout 4) - Turbo Pug 2
notes.notes:
Dear friends, customers, Turbo Pug squishers, I DID ask you all not to squish your pugs in the game description and it seems you've squished a few million! 

[H1]32-bit/64-bit Fix![/H1]
Sorry about that guys, I had a minor boo-boo with the game build. It's all fixed now and I'm working on new Pugs, costumers, characters and abilities for characters. If you have a 32-bit OR 64-bit windows, you can now enjoy Turbo Pug. 

[H1]A HUGE thanks[/H1]
Please keep spamming the Turbo Pug Steam community forums with feedback and your love of pugs.

[H1]Turbo Pug 2?[/H1]
Turbo Pug 2 is going to be a thing, a much deeper game. Turbo Pug has proved that a simple runner, crafted with love, care and pugs CAN work for PC. You should all expect a much better and content rich game with T.P.2


[H1]Leaderboard Competition info![/H1]
Dear cheaters, people cheating the poor pugs up to the top of the leaderboards, we have a few fixes coming to stop your evil in it's tracks. Plus, cheaters simply wont win a prize. A big congrats to the few players that made it to 100k pug points in a single run. My personal best was 16000 ish, so well done!

Pug love to you all!
Dan.
ːMerryPugmasːːSuperPugːːPuglifeːːSpaceKittenːːGoldenPugAwardː
